dataset: Quantum Computing Platforms bug annotations (Paltenghi & Pradel)
task: classify manually annotated real bug versus false positive from annotation metadata text
feature_policy: Only component, symptom, bug pattern, and annotator comment are used; repository and commit fields identify groups but are excluded from text features.
limitations: This task predicts the annotation-bugs.csv real/false-positive distinction from metadata; it is not source-code classification. The repository also includes 223 curated bug cases, while the annotation table contains additional false positives.
